t_advice_summary_textbox.text: you get a multipler for 5x, and each coloured gnome is different

vb_textbox.text: The basket colours seem irrelevant so ignore those. I noticed that the tall gnomes usually earned more points than the small gnomes. The brown gnome seemed to always be the best to pick when facing off against the smaller yellow or orange gnome. I feel like when you are faced with a red vs yellow small gnome, it changes the pattern slightly. But always go for the large gnomes first, then the small orange one.
